metadata.title: Configure Blog Features and Draft Workflow

story.iWant: to configure blog features (reading time, RSS feed, pagination) and draft workflow
story.soThat: I can manage unpublished content and provide reader-friendly blog features
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Configure Blog Plugin Options (AC: #1, #3) - Update docusaurus.config.ts blog preset configuration - Enable showReadingTime: true - Configure feedOptions for RSS and Atom feeds - Set onInlineTags: 'warn' and onUntruncatedBlogPosts: 'warn' - Configure pagination (postsPerPage) - Verify blog sidebar configuration (recent posts)
- Task 2: Test Draft Workflow (AC: #2) - Create a test draft post with draft: true in front matter - Verify draft visible in development mode (npm start) - Run production build (npm run build) - Confirm draft excluded from production build output - Test removing draft: true flag makes post published - Delete test draft after validation
- Task 3: Validate RSS and Atom Feeds (AC: #1) - Start dev server or build production site - Access /blog/rss.xml and verify feed content - Access /blog/atom.xml and verify feed content - Confirm feed includes published posts (not drafts) - Validate feed XML structure (use online validator if needed)
- Task 4: Verify Reading Time and Pagination (AC: #1) - Check existing blog posts display reading time estimate - Verify reading time calculation is reasonable (words per minute) - Confirm pagination works if more posts than postsPerPage limit - Test blog sidebar shows recent posts (if configured)
- Task 5: Document Draft Workflow in README (AC: #4) - Add "Writing Blog Posts" section to README.md - Document how to create drafts with draft: true flag - Explain draft visibility (dev vs production) - Document how to publish (remove draft flag or set to false) - List available blog features (RSS, reading time, pagination) - Include example front matter with draft flag

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC#1: Blog Features Enabled - The following blog features are configured in docusaurus.config.ts: - Reading time estimation displayed on posts - RSS feed generated at /blog/rss.xml - Atom feed generated at /blog/atom.xml - Pagination configured (posts per page limit) - Blog sidebar shows recent posts
AC#2: Draft Workflow Configured - Draft functionality works correctly: - Posts with draft: true in front matter are hidden in production builds - Drafts are visible in development mode (npm start) - Production build (npm run build) excludes draft posts - Clear distinction between draft and published content
AC#3: Blog Plugin Options Optimized - The blog preset configuration includes: - showReadingTime: true - Display reading time on posts - feedOptions configured for RSS and Atom feeds - onInlineTags: 'warn' - Warn about inline tags for content quality - onUntruncatedBlogPosts: 'warn' - Remind to add excerpts - Proper blog path and permalink configuration
AC#4: Documentation Complete - README.md includes: - How to create a new draft (using draft: true flag) - How to publish a draft (remove or set draft: false) - When posts become published and trigger syndication - Blog features overview (RSS, reading time, pagination)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Articles placed in /drafts directory are not published. Drafts visible in local preview via Docker Compose. Moving article from /drafts to /posts or /articles makes it publishable.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: docker-compose up starts local Jekyll/Hugo instance. Live reload on file changes (hot reload). Drafts and published articles both visible locally.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Use Docusaurus 3.x with GitHub Actions deployment. Modern DX with React/Node.js ecosystem, MDX Support for embed React components, TypeScript for type safety.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Blog posts live in blog/ directory. Supports both .md (markdown) and .mdx (markdown + JSX) formats. Front matter parsed using gray-matter library.

tests.standards:
This is a configuration story focused on blog plugin settings and documentation. Testing approach is manual validation: - Development mode testing (npm start) to verify drafts visible - Production build testing (npm run build) to verify drafts excluded - RSS/Atom feed validation by accessing /blog/rss.xml and /blog/atom.xml - Reading time display validation on existing blog posts - Documentation review to ensure README completeness
No automated tests required for this configuration-focused story. Future stories may add E2E tests for blog functionality using Docusaurus test utilities if needed.
